title: A Mundari-English dictionary
author: Manindra Bhusan Bhaduri

manifestations_verified.state: Open Library and two later CiNii reprint records point to a Calcutta University Press manifestation dated 1931; exact lawfully inspectable full text was not established in this cycle.
CiNii and Open Library catalogue manifestation verified; CiNii describes this as a reprint of Calcutta University Press, 1931.
CiNii catalogue manifestation verified; catalogue notes it as a reprint of Calcutta University Press, 1931.

CiNii catalogue manifestation verified; catalogue describes a reprint and includes an introduction by Rai Bahadur Sarat Chandra Roy. Its note says 'Originally published of 1929 ed. [intro.]', which conflicts with the 1931 original-publication note in the 1983 and 1994 CiNii records.

signals: CiNii BA27135864 (1983 reprint) says originally published Calcutta University Press, 1931.
CiNii BA31909026 (1994 reprint) says originally published Calcutta University Press, 1931.
CiNii BB09153012 (2002 reprint) notes 'Originally published of 1929 ed. [intro.]'.
edition_date_uncertainty.decision: Do not collapse 1929 and 1931 into a fabricated single original-edition date. Preserve the conflict until a primary title page/catalogue record resolves whether 1929 denotes an introduction/edition state or a distinct manifestation.

deduplication.reason: The verified records describe manifestations/reprints of the same dictionary work; creating one source identity per reprint would inflate the census.

promotion_boundary.permitted_now: bibliographic identity, manifestation relationships, catalogue identifiers, pagination metadata and explicit catalogue-date uncertainty

release_value: Reduces duplicate-risk in the Master Munda Source Census, adds a second independent exact catalogue identifier for the 1983 manifestation, and converts a hidden edition-date inconsistency into an explicit audited gap rather than silently normalizing it.
